build_custom_logger_callback: build a custom litellm callback class that extends CustomLogger to log LLM requests and responses to an external service
create_async_logging_hook: create an async logging hook to mask sensitive data in request and response payloads before they are logged
redact_standard_logging_payload: redact messages and responses from the standard logging payload when turn_off_message_logging is enabled
strip_base64_from_messages: strip inline base64-encoded file data from messages and responses in the logging payload to reduce payload size
handle_callback_failure: handle callback logging failures by incrementing prometheus metrics for the failed callback
